display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 根据金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)的规定,当金融机构(FI)发现需要提交可疑活动报告(SAR)的可疑活动时,SAR的支持性文件应(选择两项).

options.A: 包括所有协助FI作出该活动需要提交申报这一决定的文件或记录.
options.B: 始终仅限于账户名称、账户详情和交易记录.
options.C: 按照书面政策和程序予以维护.
options.D: 保存在一个单独的文件中,并将纸质副本存放在防火柜里.

stem_en: According to FinCEN, when a financial institution (FI) identifies suspicious activity that necessitates a suspicious activity report (SAR) filing, the SAR supporting documentation should: (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Include all documents or records that assisted the FI in making the determination that the activity required a filing
options_en.B: Always be limited to account name, account details, and transaction records
options_en.C: Have written policies and procedures to maintain supporting documentation
options_en.D: Be saved in a single separate file with hard copies stored in a fireproof cabinet
